_comment: Every field type a PowerFlow filter can be on, and the exact operators the filter editor (triggers, Search Records) and the Condition step offer for it: the operators each offered before, then the report filter's operators the type was missing. Read by pipeline-filter-operator-matrix.spec.ts (UI) and PipelineFilterOperatorMatrixTests (API): the UI must offer exactly these, and the API must save, evaluate and search with every one of them. A time of day (Time, Formula_Time, a Lookup of a Time) is its own category, TIME: compared as a time and entered with a time input.
